## Walkthrough Adds an IBM Cloud API endpoint override through shared provisioning options, command flags, and client construction. The client now derives IAM and Resource Manager URLs from the override, and `.gitignore` adds a `/ccoctl-*` pattern. ### Changes **IBM Cloud API endpoint override** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Command wiring**
`pkg/cmd/provisioning/ibmcloud/ibmcloud.go`, `pkg/cmd/provisioning/ibmcloud/create_service_id.go`, `pkg/cmd/provisioning/ibmcloud/delete_service_id.go`, `pkg/cmd/provisioning/ibmcloud/refresh-keys.go`|The shared options struct adds `APIEndpoint`, and the create, delete, and refresh commands add `--api-endpoint` flags and pass the value into client initialization.| |**Client endpoint routing**
`pkg/ibmcloud/client.go`|`ClientParams` gains an API endpoint field, and `NewClient` validates the override, derives IAM and Resource Manager URLs, and applies them to the IBM Cloud client options before construction.| |**Validation and support**
`pkg/ibmcloud/client_test.go`, `.gitignore`|Table-driven tests cover endpoint normalization and client URL construction for default, bare-domain, HTTPS, and invalid endpoint inputs, and `.gitignore` adds `/ccoctl-*` to the ignore patterns.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant CreateServiceIDCmd participant DeleteServiceIDCmd participant RefreshKeysCmd participant NewClient participant IBMCloudSDK CreateServiceIDCmd->>NewClient: APIEndpoint from options DeleteServiceIDCmd->>NewClient: APIEndpoint from options RefreshKeysCmd->>NewClient: APIEndpoint from options NewClient->>IBMCloudSDK: configure IAM and Resource Manager URLs IBMCloudSDK-->>NewClient: service clients ```

>Add a `--staging` flag to `ccoctl ibmcloud` subcommands to support IBM Cloud credential provisioning against Staging API endpoints. This enables creation of credential creation workflows on staging sites.
>
>### Changes
>
>**New `--staging` CLI flag** added to the following `ccoctl ibmcloud` subcommands:
>- `create-service-id`
>- `delete-service-id`
>- `refresh-keys`
>
>When `--staging` is set, all IBM Cloud API calls are redirected to their corresponding pre-production endpoints.
>
>**IBM Cloud client (`pkg/ibmcloud/client.go`)**:
>- Added `Staging bool` field to `ClientParams`
>- Defined staging endpoint constants:
>  - `StagingIAMURL` → `https://iam.test.cloud.ibm.com`
>  - `StagingPolicyManagementURL` → `https://iam.test.cloud.ibm.com`
>  - `StagingResourceManagerURL` → `https://resource-controller.test.cloud.ibm.com`
>- When `Staging: true`, the IAM authenticator URL, IAM Identity client, IAM Policy Management client, and Resource Manager client are all overridden with their staging equivalents
>
>**`.gitignore`**: Added `/ccoctl-*` to ignore platform-specific `ccoctl` build artifacts (e.g. `ccoctl-linux-amd64`)
>
>### Notes
>
>- The `--staging` flag is opt-in and has no effect on normal production usage
>- Staging endpoints are only meaningful with a staging IBM Cloud API key
>- Tested against current repository tests (all pass) and locally to confirm that service IDs do indeed get created on staging.
>

pkg/ibmcloud/client.go (1)
`94-97`: _🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Add basic validation for `APIEndpoint` input.** The `APIEndpoint` value is interpolated directly into URLs without any validation. A user accidentally passing a value with a scheme (e.g. `https://test.cloud.ibm.com`) or a trailing slash would produce malformed URLs like `https://iam.https://test.cloud.ibm.com`, leading to confusing runtime errors from the SDK clients rather than a clear validation message.
🛡️ Suggested validation ```diff if params.APIEndpoint != "" { + if strings.Contains(params.APIEndpoint, "://") || strings.Contains(params.APIEndpoint, "/") { + return nil, fmt.Errorf("APIEndpoint must be a base domain (e.g. test.cloud.ibm.com), got: %s", params.APIEndpoint) + } iamURL = fmt.Sprintf("https://iam.%s", params.APIEndpoint) resourceManagerURL = fmt.Sprintf("https://resource-controller.%s", params.APIEndpoint) } ```
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. In `@pkg/ibmcloud/client.go` around lines 94 - 97, The URL construction in the IBM Cloud client setup uses APIEndpoint directly, so add basic validation before building iamURL and resourceManagerURL in the client initialization path. In the code that handles params.APIEndpoint, reject values that already include a scheme or a trailing slash, and return a clear validation error instead of interpolating them into the URLs. Keep the fix localized around the APIEndpoint handling and the URL formatting logic so malformed input is caught early. ```
